In order to advance in tiers of weapons and armor, you will need to defeat the bosses located in the pre-hard section. These will respectively grant use to Iron, Gold, Emerald and Diamond.
Work on these bosses as you see fit to your progress. I recommended going around the map looking for chests filled with loot to use for these battles.
Make sure you are claiming and following the quests listed in the quest book.
SEVIN CURSES RING: This is considered hard mode. Do NOT put it on unless you 100% want to. Once it is on, you cannot take it off.
